key_gap: vs baseline: the v5 non-routed run stopped at instability — it correctly blocked the rollout but commissioned a fresh 2-week experiment to 'separate signal from artifact,' while the human's decisive check (definition invariance: recompute the outcome under an alternative operationalization computable from the held clickstream) overturned the result outright (+0.2 pp, n.s.) and named the mechanism (auto-completed tutorial inflating Flow B's activation, concentrated in paid-search). The routed v6 run closed that gap: the m035 first-class pass made the definition-invariance check a mandatory HOW output (completion contract: replication conditions named, >=2 P4 robustness perturbations, artifact-vs-effect discrimination), so the artifact is found in existing data and the new-experiment alternative is suppressed by the P3 gate (no new-data alternative while a held-data check is available); the dual-route m094 pass additionally exposed that the two arms measured different constructs (tap-counted vs quiz-graded tutorial completion — an instrument difference, not a behavior difference), and the m007 ruin screen (R3, high_stakes) priced the ship-artifact downside (phantom adoption, re-rollout, trust loss). Residual shared gap: clickstream reflects true behavior is an assumption, not verified — a future test should instrument both definitions simultaneously in one arm.
learning_signal: When a robustness battery overturns a single result, the decisive check is the definitional one — recompute the outcome under at least 2 alternative operationalizations computable from data already held, and run this BEFORE any new-data alternative (a gate, not a suggestion): significance tests validate a fixed metric, never the metric's construct. Deeper: before interpreting any difference between two arms, verify instrument equivalence — if the arms' instruments operationalize the same labeled metric differently (auto-complete vs quiz-graded completion), the comparison is between instruments, not behaviors, and statistics on it are arithmetic about the instruments. Artifact-vs-effect discrimination is the pass's terminal output: name the mechanism, show it is concentrated where it is (segment × definition), and state the conditions under which a future result would be trusted.
suggested_improvement: Keep m035 as a dual-routed first-class pass on this signature (decide/maximize + deadline/high_stakes) with the full completion contract: replication-conditions named (settings/samples/methods variations), >=2 P4 perturbations (segment, definition, window) with recomposition arithmetic, artifact-vs-effect discrimination, and trust conditions; add an 'instrument-equivalence check' item to the m035 contract — verify both arms' instruments measure the same construct before interpreting any difference; keep the P3 gate 'no new-data alternative while a definition-invariance check on held data is available' as a packet line; keep m007 as standing R3 gate for high_stakes rollout signatures (ship-vs-hold downside distribution).

key_gap: vs baseline: the pure style's reflex was variance-side — it pre-registered a 12-week, $40k second-vendor replication (samples, settings, methods, definitions, windows) and deferred the launch decision past the seasonal dip and into the competitor's window, never auditing the measurement layer: client-side telemetry drops 31% of sessions (Android 13+ background limits, ad-blockers), missingness correlates with the churn-prone users the feature targets, and the second vendor's SDK is the same client-side class, so the replication faithfully reproduces the blind spot. The routed v6 run won WHILE running the router's pick (m094, top-1 — the router keeps the trap style out of top-3): the first-class pass interrogated the null claim's evidence basis (a null on 69% of sessions, missing not at random) and the replication proposal's premise (replication is a variance remedy, never a bias remedy); the m006 gate (unmeasured) produced likelihood scenarios whose range spans the ship threshold (threshold flip demonstrated); the m019 gate (adversarial) priced the ritual's cost against the window (12 w / $40k vs 2 w, out-of-window vs in-window). Selected: instrument repair + backfill re-analysis of the SAME study, decision in ~2 weeks, both corrected outcomes pre-planned. Residual gap: backfill data quality (±0.3 pp) is named but not priceable until the backfill runs.
learning_signal: Robustness checks validate the measurement layer before the variance layer: before demanding more samples, settings, or vendors, run a coverage/missingness audit (what fraction of the population did the instrument see, and is the missingness non-random?) and a bias-vs-variance classification of the threat — replication repairs variance, never bias; a replica of a biased instrument reproduces the bias at multiplied cost, so when bias is plausible the correct move is instrument repair + re-measurement of the SAME cohort, and the cost of delay (decision windows, competitor clocks, seasonal dips) belongs IN the alternative table. For null results specifically: a null computed on a non-randomly missing subset is a finding about the instrument, not about the treatment — absence of measurement is not evidence of absence. The router's trap-avoidance pattern (NEG top-1 away from trap style, 97.2%) is what lets the agent hold the protective split while the style is installed — the trap's moves become gate-checks (measurement-validity before replication), not commands.
suggested_improvement: Keep m094 as the confident single-route first-class pass for this signature (decide/estimate/maximize + adversarial,deadline,unmeasured) — the critical-reading contract should require interrogating every decision-relevant claim's evidence basis (what does it assert, on what was measured, does the instrument see the population it claims to measure?) and every proposed remedy's premise (would the remedy's instrument see what the original missed?); add a 'coverage/missingness audit' item to the m006 gate: missingness rate + mechanism + non-randomness test, run before any NEEDS_EVIDENCE/replication demand is accepted; add a 'ritual-cost' item to the m019 gate: any delay/replication option must be priced against the earliest binding decision deadline and the baseline risk of inaction; keep tempo mode (P2) so the repair path commits at DO.
